name: lyft
strip_regex: ]*>\s*(?:Tip driver|Find lost item|Report incident|Dispute ride charges|Help center)\s*
To protect against unauthorized behavior[\s\S]*?will not be charged\.
Select 'You' on the home screen in the Lyft app[\s\S]*?additional help\.
notes: Removed from a Lyft ride receipt: both tip controls, which are the header Add tip button and the footer Tip driver button; the safety marketing block and the ride safety summary widget, both live controls rather than a record; the credit card rewards promo; the get help link cluster; the authorization hold notice; the static route map, whose URL carries the route geometry, and the OpenStreetMap credit it leaves behind; the regulatory licence block naming the dispatching base, the vehicle plate and the driver licence; the copyright and CPUC footer; and the Lyft app instruction block. Kept verbatim: the fare breakdown with its distance and duration label, every surcharge and toll row, both tender rows and their Upfront Fare sublabels, the pickup and dropoff rows with their times and addresses, and the receipt number. The hidden expense microdata block has a pattern here and the amount guard keeps it anyway: the block repeats the charged total, and a pattern that would take an amount with it is skipped rather than run, so the block stays in the fragment, where Lyft's own styling renders it as nothing. Lyft prints no Total row, so amount_regex reads the charged total from the hidden microdata block, which is parsed from the saved message before the message is cleaned for rendering; the date comes from the visible headline banner, which is kept.
